name: github-action-template-setup
description: Initial setup for the GitHub Action template. The shared setup-guard config strips the one-time gate; this config deletes setup/ afterwards, once clean-readme has read its template from there.

tasks.name: Clean README
tasks.description: Create a fresh README for the new project

tasks.name: Update CONTRIBUTING.md
tasks.description: Update contributing guidelines with project info

tasks.name: Delete setup folder
tasks.description: Remove the guard, this config and its templates -- placed after clean-readme, which reads setup/templates/clean-readme.md

tasks.name: Install dependencies
tasks.description: Run last, after the gate is gone, so the removed postinstall guard is not re-triggered
